verses.geez:
ወኮነ ፡ እምድኅረ ፡ ዝንቱ ፡ ነገር ፡ ይቤልዎ ፡ ለዮሴፍ ፡ ደክመ ፡ አቡነ ፡ ወነሥአ ፡ ዮሴፍ ፡ ክልኤ ፡ ደቂቆ ፡
                  ምናሴሃ ፡ ወኤፍሬምሃ ።
verses.translation: And it came to pass after these things, that it was reported to Joseph, Behold, thy father is ill; and, having taken his two sons, Manasse and Ephraim, he came to Jacob.

translations.lxx: And it came to pass after these things, that it was reported to Joseph, Behold, thy father is ill; and, having taken his two sons, Manasse and Ephraim, he came to Jacob.
translations.kjv: And it came to pass after these things, that one told Joseph, Behold, thy father is sick: and he took with him his two sons, Manasseh and Ephraim.
translations.ron: După aceea i s-a spus lui Iosif: "Tatăl tău e bolnav". Atunci a luat el cu sine pe cei doi fii ai săi, pe Manase şi pe Efraim, şi a venit la Iacov.
translations.grk: Ἐγένετο δὲ μετὰ τὰ ῥήματα ταῦτα, καὶ ἀπηγγέλη τῷ Ἰωσὴφ, ὅτι ὁ πατήρ σου ἐνοχλεῖται· καὶ ἀναλαβὼν τοὺς δύο υἱοὺς αὐτοῦ τὸν Μανασσῆ καὶ τὸν Ἐφραὶμ, ἦλθε πρὸς Ἰακώβ.

verses.geez:
ወይቤልዎ ፡ ለእስራኤል ፡ ናሁ ፡ ወልድከ ፡ ዮሴፍ ፡ ይመጽእ ፡ ኀቤከ ፡ ወተኀየለ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ ወነበረ ፡ ዲበ ፡
                  ምስካቢሁ ።
verses.translation: And it was reported to Jacob, saying, Behold, thy son Joseph cometh to thee; and Israel having strengthened himself, sat upon the bed.

translations.lxx: And it was reported to Jacob, saying, Behold, thy son Joseph cometh to thee; and Israel having strengthened himself, sat upon the bed.
translations.kjv: And one told Jacob, and said, Behold, thy son Joseph cometh unto thee: and Israel strengthened himself, and sat upon the bed.
translations.ron: Şi i s-a dat de veste lui Iacov, spunându-i-se: "Iată Iosif, fiul tău, vine să te vadă". Şi Israel, adunându-şi puterile sale, s-a ridicat în pat.
translations.grk: Ἀπηγγέλη δὲ τῷ Ἰακὼβ, λέγοντες, ἰδοὺ ὁ υἱός σου Ἰωσὴφ ἔρχεται πρὸς σέ· καὶ ἐνισχύσας Ἰσραὴλ ἐκάθισεν ἐπὶ τὴν κλίνην.

verses.geez: ወይቤሎ ፡ ያዕቆብ ፡ ለዮሴፍ ፡ አምላኪየ ፡ ዘአስተርአየኒ ፡ በሉዛ ፡ በምድረ ፡ ከናአን ፡ ወባረከኒ ፤
verses.translation: And Jacob said to Joseph, My God appeared to me in Luza, in the land of Chanaan, and blessed me,

translations.lxx: And Jacob said to Joseph, My God appeared to me in Luza, in the land of Chanaan, and blessed me,
translations.kjv: And Jacob said unto Joseph, God Almighty appeared unto me at Luz in the land of Canaan, and blessed me,
translations.ron: Şi a zis Iacov către Iosif: "Dumnezeu Atotputernicul mi S-a arătat în Luz, în pământul Canaan şi m-a binecuvântat.
translations.grk: Καὶ εἶπεν Ἰακὼβ τῷ Ἰωσὴφ, ὁ Θεός μου ὤφθη μοι ἐν Λουζᾷ ἐν γῇ Χαναὰν, καὶ εὐλόγησέ με,

verses.geez:
ወይቤለኒ ፡ ናሁ ፡ አነ ፡ ኣበዝኀከ ፡ ወኣስተበዝኀከ ፡ ወእገብረከ ፡ ማኅበረ ፡ አሕዛብ ፡ ወእሁበካሃ ፡ ለዛቲ ፡ ምድር
                  ፡ ወለዘርእከ ፡ እምድኅሬከ ፡ ከመ ፡ ይምልክዋ ፡ ለዓለም ።
verses.translation: and said to me, Behold, I will increase thee, and multiply thee, and will make of thee multitudes of nations; and I will give this land to thee, and to thy seed after thee, for an everlasting possession.

translations.lxx: and said to me, Behold, I will increase thee, and multiply thee, and will make of thee multitudes of nations; and I will give this land to thee, and to thy seed after thee, for an everlasting possession.
translations.kjv: And said unto me, Behold, I will make thee fruitful, and multiply thee, and I will make of thee a multitude of people; and will give this land to thy seed after thee for an everlasting possession.
translations.ron: Şi mi-a zis: "Iată, te voi creşte şi te voi înmulţi, şi voi ridica din tine mulţime de popoare, şi pământul acesta îl voi da urmaşilor tăi, ca moştenire veşnică".
translations.grk: καὶ εἶπέ μοι, ἰδοὺ ἐγὼ αὐξανῶ σε, καὶ πληθυνῶ σε, καὶ ποιήσω σε εἰς συναγωγὰς ἐθνῶν· καὶ δώσω σοι τὴν γῆν ταύτην, καὶ τῷ σπέρματί σου μετὰ σὲ, εἰς κατάσχεσιν αἰώνιον.

verses.geez:
ወይእዜኒ ፡ እሉ ፡ ደቂቅከ ፡ ክልኤቱ ፡ እለ ፡ ተወልዱ ፡ ለከ ፡ በብሔረ ፡ ግብጽ ፡ ዘእንበለ ፡ እምጻእ ፡ አነ ፡ ዝየ
                  ፡ ኀቤከ ፡ ኤፍሬም ፡ ወምናሴ ፡ ከመ ፡ ሩቤል ፡ ወስምዖን ፡ ሊተ ፡ እሙንቱ ።
verses.translation: Now then thy two sons, who were born to thee in the land of Egypt, before I came to thee into Egypt, are mine; Ephraim and Manasse, as Ruben and Symeon they shall be mine.

translations.lxx: Now then thy two sons, who were born to thee in the land of Egypt, before I came to thee into Egypt, are mine; Ephraim and Manasse, as Ruben and Symeon they shall be mine.
translations.kjv: And now thy two sons, Ephraim and Manasseh, which were born unto thee in the land of Egypt before I came unto thee into Egypt, are mine; as Reuben and Simeon, they shall be mine.
translations.ron: Acum deci cei doi fii ai tăi, care ţi s-au născut în pământul Egiptului, înainte de a veni eu la tine în Egipt, să fie ai mei; Efraim şi Manase să fie ai mei, ca Ruben şi Simeon.
translations.grk: Νῦν οὖν οἱ δύο υἱοί σου, οἱ γενόμενοί σοι ἐν γῇ Αἰγύπτῳ πρὸ τοῦ με ἐλθεῖν πρός σε εἰς Αἴγυπτον, ἐμοί εἰσιν, Ἐφραὶμ καὶ Μανασσῆ· ὡς Ῥουβὴν καὶ Συμεὼν ἔσονταί μοι.

verses.geez: ወእመቦ ፡ ዘወለድከ ፡ እምይእዜ ፡ ይኩኑ ፡ በስመ ፡ አኀዊሆሙ ፡ ወይሰመዩ ፡ ወይኩኑ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ክፍለ ፡ አኀዊሆሙ ።
verses.translation: And the children which thou shalt beget hereafter, shall be in the name of their brethren; they shall be named after their inheritances.

translations.lxx: And the children which thou shalt beget hereafter, shall be in the name of their brethren; they shall be named after their inheritances.
translations.kjv: And thy issue, which thou begettest after them, shall be thine, and shall be called after the name of their brethren in their inheritance.
translations.ron: Iar copiii, ce se vor naşte de acum din tine, să fie ai tăi şi se vor numi ei cu numele fraţilor lor, în triburile acelora.
translations.grk: Τὰ δὲ ἔκγονα, ἃ ἐὰν γεννήσῃς μετὰ ταῦτα, ἔσονται ἐπὶ τῷ ὀνόματι τῶν ἀδελφῶν αὐτῶν· κληθήσονται ἐπὶ τοῖς ἐκείνων κλήροις.

verses.geez:
ወአመ ፡ መጻእኩ ፡ አነ ፡ እምስጴጦምያ ፡ ዘሶርያ ፡ ሞተት ፡ ራሔል ፡ እምከ ፡ በምድረ ፡ ከናአን ፡ ሶአበ ፡ ቀረብኩ ፡
                  ኀበ ፡ ምርዋጸ ፡ አፍራስ ፡ ብሔረ ፡ ኤፍራታ ፡ ለበጺሐ ፡ ኤፍራታ ፡ ወቀበርክዋ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ፍኖት ፡ ዘምርዋጸ ፡ አፍሪስ ፡
                  ዘስሙ ፡ ቤተ ፡ ሌሔም ።
verses.translation: And as for me, when I came out of Mesopotamia of Syria, Rachel, thy mother, died in the land of Chanaan, as I drew nigh to the horse-course of Chabratha of the land of Chanaan, so as to come to Ephratha; and I buried her in the road of the course; this is Bethlehem.

translations.lxx: And as for me, when I came out of Mesopotamia of Syria, Rachel, thy mother, died in the land of Chanaan, as I drew nigh to the horse-course of Chabratha of the land of Chanaan, so as to come to Ephratha; and I buried her in the road of the course; this is Bethlehem.
translations.kjv: And as for me, when I came from Padan, Rachel died by me in the land of Canaan in the way, when yet there was but a little way to come unto Ephrath: and I buried her there in the way of Ephrath; the same is Bethlehem.
translations.ron: Când veneam eu din Mesopotamia, mi-a murit Rahila, mama ta, pe drum, în pământul Canaan, puţin înainte de a ajunge la Efrata, şi am îngropat-o acolo, lângă drumul spre Efrata sau Betleem".
translations.grk: Ἐγὼ δὲ ἡνίκα ἠρχόμην ἐκ Μεσοποταμίας τῆς Συρίας, ἀπέθανε Ῥαχὴλ ἡ μήτηρ σου ἐν γῇ Χαναὰν, ἐγγίζοντός μου κατὰ τὸν ἱππόδρομον Χαβραθὰ τῆς γῆς, τοῦ ἐλθεῖν Ἐφραθά· καὶ κατώρυξα αὐτὴν ἐν τῇ ὁδῷ τοῦ ἱπποδρόμου· αὕτη ἐστὶ Βηθλεέμ.

verses.geez: ወሶበ ፡ ርእየ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ ደቂቆ ፡ ለዮሴፍ ፡ ይቤሎ ፡ ምንትከ ፡ እሉ ።
verses.translation: And when Israel saw the sons of Joseph, he said, Who are these to thee?

translations.lxx: And when Israel saw the sons of Joseph, he said, Who are these to thee?
translations.kjv: And Israel beheld Joseph’s sons, and said, Who are these?
translations.ron: Văzând apoi pe fiii lui Iosif, Israel a zis: "Cine sunt aceştia?"
translations.grk: Ἰδὼν δὲ Ἰσραὴλ τοὺς υἱοὺς Ἰωσὴφ, εἶπε, τίνες σοι οὗτοι;

verses.geez:
ወይቤሎ ፡ ዮሴፍ ፡ ለአቡሁ ፡ ደቂቅየ ፡ እለ ፡ ወሀበኒ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ በዝየ ፡ ወይቤሎ ፡ ያዕቆብ ፡ አምጽኦሙ ፡
                  ኀቤየ ፡ ከመ ፡ እባርኮሙ ።
verses.translation: And Joseph said to his father, They are my sons, whom God gave me here; and Jacob said, Bring me them, that I may bless them.

translations.lxx: And Joseph said to his father, They are my sons, whom God gave me here; and Jacob said, Bring me them, that I may bless them.
translations.kjv: And Joseph said unto his father, They are my sons, whom God hath given me in this place. And he said, Bring them, I pray thee, unto me, and I will bless them.
translations.ron: Răspuns-a Iosif tatălui său: "Aceştia sunt fiii mei, pe care mi i-a dat Dumnezeu aici!" Iar Iacov a zis: "Apropie-i de mine ca să-i binecuvântez!"
translations.grk: Εἶπε δὲ Ἰωσὴφ τῷ πατρὶ αὐτοῦ, υἱοί μου εἰσὶν, οὓς ἔδωκε μοι ὁ Θεὸς ἐνταῦθα. Καὶ εἶπεν Ἰακὼβ, προσάγαγέ μοι αὐτοὺς, ἵνα εὐλογήσω αὐτούς.

verses.geez:
ወአዕይንቲሁ ፡ ለእስራኤል ፡ ከብደ ፡ ወተከድና ፡ እምርሥእ ፡ ወኢይክል ፡ ከሢቶተ ፡ ወነጽሮ ፡ ወአቅረቦሙ ፡ ኀቤሁ ፡
                  ወሰዐሞሙ ፡ ወሐቀፎሙ ።
verses.translation: Now the eyes of Israel were dim through age, and he could not see; and he brought them near to him, and he kissed them, and embraced them.

translations.lxx: Now the eyes of Israel were dim through age, and he could not see; and he brought them near to him, and he kissed them, and embraced them.
translations.kjv: Now the eyes of Israel were dim for age, so that he could not see. And he brought them near unto him; and he kissed them, and embraced them.
translations.ron: Ochii lui Israel însă erau întunecaţi de bătrâneţe şi nu mai puteau să vadă. Şi a apropiat Iosif pe fiii săi de el, iar el i-a îmbrăţişat şi i-a sărutat.
translations.grk: Οἱ ὀφθαλμοὶ δὲ Ἰσραὴλ ἐβαρυώπησαν ἀπὸ τοῦ γήρως, καὶ οὐκ ἠδύνατο βλέπειν· καὶ ἤγγισεν αὐτοὺς πρὸς αὐτὸν, καὶ ἐφίλησεν αὐτοὺς, καὶ περιέλαβεν αὐτους.

verses.geez: ወይቤሎ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ ለዮሴፍ ፡ ናሁ ፡ ኢተፈለጥኩ ፡ እምገጽከ ፡ ወናሁ ፡ ዘርአከኒ ፡ አርአየኒ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ።
verses.translation: And Israel said to Joseph, Behold, I have not been deprived of seeing thy face, and lo! God has showed me thy seed also.

translations.lxx: And Israel said to Joseph, Behold, I have not been deprived of seeing thy face, and lo! God has showed me thy seed also.
translations.kjv: And Israel said unto Joseph, I had not thought to see thy face: and, lo, God hath shewed me also thy seed.
translations.ron: Apoi a zis iarăşi Israel către Iosif: "Nu nădăjduiam să mai văd faţa ta şi iată Dumnezeu mi-a arătat şi pe urmaşii tăi".
translations.grk: Καὶ εἶπεν Ἰσραὴλ πρὸς Ἰωσὴφ, ἰδοὺ τοῦ προσώπου σου οὐκ ἐστερήθην, καὶ ἰδοὺ ἔδειξέ μοι ὁ Θεὸς καὶ τὸ σπέρμα σου.

verses.geez: ወአውፅኦሙ ፡ ዮሴፍ ፡ እማእከለ ፡ ብረኪሁ ፡ ወሰገደ ፡ ሎቱ ፡ በገጹ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ምድር ።
verses.translation: And Joseph brought them out from between his knees, and they did reverence to him, with their face to the ground.

translations.lxx: And Joseph brought them out from between his knees, and they did reverence to him, with their face to the ground.
translations.kjv: And Joseph brought them out from between his knees, and he bowed himself with his face to the earth.
translations.ron: Şi depărtându-i de genunchii tatălui său, Iosif i s-a închinat lui Israel până la pământ.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐξήγαγεν αὐτοὺς Ἰωσὴφ ἀπὸ τῶν γονάτων αὐτοῦ· καὶ προσεκύνησαν αὐτῷ ἐπὶ πρόσωπον ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς.

verses.geez:
ወነሥኦሙ ፡ ዮሴፍ ፡ ለክልኤሆሙ ፡ ደቂቁ ፡ ወአቀሞ ፡ ለኤፍሬም ፡ በየማኑ ፡ ኀበ ፡ ፀጋመ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ ወለምናሴ ፡
                  አቀሞ ፡ በፀጋሙ ፡ ኀበ ፡ የማነ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ ወአቀረቦሙ ፡ ኀበ ፡ አቡሁ ።
verses.translation: And Joseph took his two sons, both Ephraim in his right hand, but on the left of Israel, and Manasse on his left hand, but on the right of Israel, and brought them near to him.

translations.lxx: And Joseph took his two sons, both Ephraim in his right hand, but on the left of Israel, and Manasse on his left hand, but on the right of Israel, and brought them near to him.
translations.kjv: And Joseph took them both, Ephraim in his right hand toward Israel’s left hand, and Manasseh in his left hand toward Israel’s right hand, and brought them near unto him.
translations.ron: După aceea luând Iosif pe cei doi fii ai săi, pe Efraim cu dreapta sa în faţa stângei lui Israel, iar pe Manase cu stânga sa în fala dreptei lui Israel, i-a apropiat de el.
translations.grk: Λαβὼν δὲ Ἰωσὴφ τοὺς δύο υἱοὺς αὐτοῦ, τόν τε Ἐφραὶμ ἐν τῇ δεξιᾷ, ἐξ ἀριστερῶν δὲ Ἰσραὴλ, τὸν δὲ Μανασσῆ ἐξ ἀριστερῶν, ἐκ δεξιῶν δὲ Ἰσραὴλ, ἤγγισεν αὐτοὺς αὐτῷ.

verses.geez:
ወሰፍሐ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ እዴሁ ፡ እንተ ፡ የማን ፡ ወወደያ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ርእሰ ፡ ኤፍሬም ፡ ወውእቱ ፡ ይንእስ ፡ እምነ ፡
                  እኁሁ ፡ ወእዴሁ ፡ እንተ ፡ ፀጋም ፡ ወደያ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ርእሰ ፡ ምናሴ ፡ ወአስተኀለፈ ፡ እዴሁ ።
verses.translation: But Israel having stretched out his right hand, laid it on the head of Ephraim, and he was the younger; and his left hand on the head of Manasse, guiding his hands crosswise.

translations.lxx: But Israel having stretched out his right hand, laid it on the head of Ephraim, and he was the younger; and his left hand on the head of Manasse, guiding his hands crosswise.
translations.kjv: And Israel stretched out his right hand, and laid it upon Ephraim’s head, who was the younger, and his left hand upon Manasseh’s head, guiding his hands wittingly; for Manasseh was the firstborn.
translations.ron: Israel insă şi-a întins mâna sa cea dreaptă şi a pus-o pe capul lui Efraim, deşi acesta era mai mic, iar stânga şi-a pus-o pe capul lui Manase. Înadins şi-a încrucişat mâinile, deşi Manase era întâiul născut.
translations.grk: Ἐκτείνας δὲ Ἰσραὴλ τὴν χεῖρα τὴν δεξιὰν, ἐπέβαλεν ἐπὶ τὴν κεφαλὴν Ἐφραὶμ, οὗτος δὲ ἦν ὁ νεώτερος, καὶ τὴν ἀριστερὰν ἐπὶ τὴν κεφαλὴν Μανασσῆ, ἐναλλὰξ τὰς χεῖρας.

verses.geez:
ወባረኮሙ ፡ ወይቤ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ዘአሥመርዎ ፡ አበዊየ ፡ ቅድሜሁ ፡ አብርሃም ፡ ወይስሐቅ ፡ ወእግዚአብሔር ፡
                  ውእቱ ፡ ዘሐፀነኒ ፡ ወሴሰየኒ ፡ እምንእስየ ፡ እስከ ፡ ይእዜ ፡ ወእስከ ፡ ዛቲ ፡ ዕለት ፤
verses.translation: And he blessed them and said, The God in whose sight my fathers were well pleasing, even Abraam and Isaac, the God who continues to feed me from my youth until this day;

translations.lxx: And he blessed them and said, The God in whose sight my fathers were well pleasing, even Abraam and Isaac, the God who continues to feed me from my youth until this day;
translations.kjv: And he blessed Joseph, and said, God, before whom my fathers Abraham and Isaac did walk, the God which fed me all my life long unto this day,
translations.ron: Şi i-a binecuvântat, zicând: "Dumnezeul, înaintea Căruia au umblat părinţii mei: Avraam şi Isaac, Dumnezeul Cel ce m-a călăuzit de când sunt şi până în ziua aceasta;
translations.grk: Καὶ εὐλόγησεν αὐτοὺς, καὶ εἶπεν, ὁ Θεὸς, ᾧ εὐηρέστησαν οἱ πατέρες μου ἐνώπιον αὐτοῦ, Ἁβραὰμ καὶ Ἰσαὰκ, ὁ Θεὸς ὁ τρέφων με ἐκ νεότητος ἕως τῆς ἡμέρας ταύτης,

verses.geez:
ወመልአከ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ዘአድኀነኒ ፡ እምኵሉ ፡ እኪት ፡ ውእቱ ፡ ለይባርኮሙ ፡ ለእሉ ፡ ሕፃናት ፡ ወይሰመይ ፡ ስምየ
                  ፡ በላዕሌሆሙ ፡ ወስመ ፡ አበዊየ ፡ አብርሃም ፡ ወይስሐቅ ፡ ወይብዝኁ ፡ ወይትባዝኁ ፡ ወይምልኡ ፡ ዲበ ፡ ምድር ።
verses.translation: the angel who delivers me from all evils, bless these boys, and my name shall be called upon them, and the name of my fathers, Abraam and Isaac; and let them be increased to a great multitude on the earth.

translations.lxx: the angel who delivers me from all evils, bless these boys, and my name shall be called upon them, and the name of my fathers, Abraam and Isaac; and let them be increased to a great multitude on the earth.
translations.kjv: The Angel which redeemed me from all evil, bless the lads; and let my name be named on them, and the name of my fathers Abraham and Isaac; and let them grow into a multitude in the midst of the earth.
translations.ron: Îngerul ce m-a izbăvit pe mine de tot răul să binecuvânteze pruncii aceştia, să poarte ei numele meu şi numele părinţilor mei: Avraam şi Isaac, şi să crească din ei mulţime mare pe pământ!"
translations.grk: ὁ Ἄγγελος ὁ ῥυόμενός με ἐκ πάντων τῶν κακῶν, εὐλογήσαι τὰ παιδία ταῦτα· καὶ ἐπικληθήσεται ἐν αὐτοις τὸ ὄνομά μου, καὶ τὸ ὄνομα τῶν πατέρων μου Ἁβραὰμ καὶ Ἰσαάκ· καὶ πληθυνθείησαν εἰς πλῆθος πολὺ ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς.

verses.geez:
ወሶበ ፡ ርእየ ፡ ዮሴፍ ፡ ከመ ፡ ወደየ ፡ እደሁ ፡ አቡሁ ፡ እንተ ፡ የማን ፡ ውስተ ፡ ርእሰ ፡ ኤፍሬም ፡ ወእንተ ፡
                  ፀጋም ፡ ላዕለ ፡ ርእሰ ፡ ምናሴ ፤
verses.translation: And Joseph having seen that his father put his right hand on the head of Ephraim—it seemed grievous to him; and Joseph took hold of the hand of his father, to remove it from the head of Ephraim to the head of Manasse.

translations.lxx: And Joseph having seen that his father put his right hand on the head of Ephraim—it seemed grievous to him; and Joseph took hold of the hand of his father, to remove it from the head of Ephraim to the head of Manasse.
translations.kjv: And when Joseph saw that his father laid his right hand upon the head of Ephraim, it displeased him: and he held up his father’s hand, to remove it from Ephraim’s head unto Manasseh’s head.
translations.ron: Şi Iosif, văzând că tatăl său şi-a pus mâna sa cea dreaptă pe capul lui Efraim, i-a părut rău şi, luând mâna tatălui său ca să o mute de pe capul lui Efraim pe capul lui Manase,
translations.grk: Ἰδὼν δὲ Ἰωσὴφ ὅτι ἐπέβαλεν ὁ πατὴρ αὐτοῦ τὴν χεῖρα τὴν δεξιὰν αὐτοῦ ἐπὶ τὴν κεφαλὴν Ἐφραὶμ, βαρὺ αὐτῷ κατεφάνη· καὶ ἀντελάβετο Ἰωσὴφ τῆς χειρὸς τοῦ πατρὸς αὐτοῦ, ἀφελεῖν αὐτὴν ἀπὸ τῆς κεφαλῆς Ἐφραὶμ ἐπὶ τὴν κεφαλὴν Μανασσῆ.

verses.geez:
ወይቤሎ ፡ ዮሴፍ ፡ ለአቡሁ ፡ አኮ ፡ ከመዝ ፡ አባ ፡ እስመ ፡ ዝንቱ ፡ በኵርየ ፡ ደይ ፡ እዴከ ፡ እንተ ፡ የማን ፡
                  ላዕሌሁ ።
verses.translation: And Joseph said to his father, Not so, father; for this is the first-born; lay thy right-hand upon his head.

translations.lxx: And Joseph said to his father, Not so, father; for this is the first-born; lay thy right-hand upon his head.
translations.kjv: And Joseph said unto his father, Not so, my father: for this is the firstborn; put thy right hand upon his head.
translations.ron: A zis către tatăl său: "Nu aşa, tată, că cestălalt este întâiul născut. Pune dar pe capul lui mâna ta cea dreaptă!"
translations.grk: Εἶπε δὲ Ἰωσὴφ τῷ πατρὶ αὐτοῦ, οὐχ οὕτως, πατὴρ, οὗτος γὰρ ὁ πρωτότοκος· ἐπίθες τὴν δεξιάν σου ἐπὶ τὴν κεφαλὴν αὐτοῦ.

verses.geez:
ወይቤሎ ፡ አአምር ፡ ወልድየ ፡ አአምር ፡ ዝኒ ፡ ይከውን ፡ ሕዝበ ፡ ወዝኒ ፡ የዐቢ ፡ አላ ፡ እኁሁ ፡ ዘይንእስ ፡
                  የዐብዮ ፡ ወዘርኡ ፡ ብዙኅ ፡ አሕዛበ ፡ ይከውን ።
verses.translation: And he would not, but said, I know it, son, I know it; he also shall be a people, and he shall be exalted, but his younger brother shall be greater than he, and his seed shall become a multitude of nations.

translations.lxx: And he would not, but said, I know it, son, I know it; he also shall be a people, and he shall be exalted, but his younger brother shall be greater than he, and his seed shall become a multitude of nations.
translations.kjv: And his father refused, and said, I know it, my son, I know it: he also shall become a people, and he also shall be great: but truly his younger brother shall be greater than he, and his seed shall become a multitude of nations.
translations.ron: Tatăl său însă n-a voit, ci a zis: "Ştiu, fiul meu, ştiu! Şi din el va ieşi un popor şi el va fi mare; dar fratele lui cel mai mic va fi mai mare decât el şi din sămânţa lui vor ieşi popoare nenumărate".
translations.grk: Καὶ οὐκ ἠθέλησεν, ἀλλʼ εἶπεν, οἶδα, τέκνον, οἶδα· καὶ οὗτος ἔσται εἰς λαὸν, καὶ οὗτος ὑψωθήσεται· ἀλλʼ ὁ ἀδελφὸς αὐτοῦ ὁ νεώτερος μείζον αὐτοῦ ἔσται, καὶ τὸ σπέρμα αὐτοῦ ἔσται εἰς πλῆθος ἐθνῶν.

verses.geez:
ወባረኮሙ ፡ በይእቲ ፡ ዕለት ፡ ወይቤ ፡ [ብክሙ ፡] ይትባረክ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ ወይ[በሉ] ፡ ይባርከ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ከመ
                  ፡ ኤፍሬም ፡ ወምናሴ ።
verses.translation: And he blessed them in that day, saying, In you shall Israel be blessed, saying, God make thee as Ephraim and Manasse; and he set Ephraim before Manasse.

translations.lxx: And he blessed them in that day, saying, In you shall Israel be blessed, saying, God make thee as Ephraim and Manasse; and he set Ephraim before Manasse.
translations.kjv: And he blessed them that day, saying, In thee shall Israel bless, saying, God make thee as Ephraim and as Manasseh: and he set Ephraim before Manasseh.
translations.ron: Şi i-a binecuvântat pe ei în ziua aceea, zicând: "Cu voi se va binecuvânta în Israel şi se va zice: Dumnezeu să te facă aşa ca pe Efraim şi ca pe Manase!" Şi aşa a pus mâna pe Efraim înaintea lui Manase.
translations.grk: Καὶ εὐλόγησεν αὐτοὺς ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ἐκείνῃ, λέγων, ἐν ὑμῖν εὐλογηθήσεται Ἰσραὴλ, λέγοντες, ποιήσαι σε ὁ Θεὸς ὡς Ἐφραὶμ καὶ ὡς Μανασσῆ· καὶ ἔθηκε τὸν Ἐφραὶμ ἔμπροσθεν τοῦ Μανασσῆ.

verses.geez:
ወይቤሎ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ ለዮሴፍ ፡ ናሁ ፡ አነ ፡ እመውት ፡ ወየሀሉ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ምስሌክሙ ፡ ወያግብእክሙ ፡ ውስተ ፡
                  ምድረ ፡ አበዊክሙ ።
verses.translation: And Israel said to Joseph, Behold, I die; and God shall be with you, and restore you to the land of your fathers.

translations.lxx: And Israel said to Joseph, Behold, I die; and God shall be with you, and restore you to the land of your fathers.
translations.kjv: And Israel said unto Joseph, Behold, I die: but God shall be with you, and bring you again unto the land of your fathers.
translations.ron: Apoi a zis Israel către Iosif: "Iată, eu mor; dar Dumnezeu va fi cu voi şi vă va întoarce în ţara părinţilor voştri.
translations.grk: Εἶπε δὲ Ἰσραὴλ τῷ Ἰωσὴφ, ἰδοὺ ἐγὼ ἀποθνήσκω· καὶ ἔσται ὁ Θεὸς μεθʼ ὑμῶν, καὶ ἀποστρέψει ὑμᾶς εἰς τὴν γῆν τῶν πατέρων ὑμῶν.

verses.geez:
ወናሁ ፡ እሁበከ ፡ ምህርካ ፡ ሠናየ ፡ ዘይኄይስ ፡ እምዘ ፡ አኀዊከ ፡ ዘነሣእኩ ፡ እምእዴሆሙ ፡ ለአሞሬዎን ፡ በቀስትየ
                  ፡ ወበኵናትየ ።
verses.translation: And I give to thee Sicima, a select portion above thy brethren, which I took out of the hand of the Amorites with my sword and bow.

translations.lxx: And I give to thee Sicima, a select portion above thy brethren, which I took out of the hand of the Amorites with my sword and bow.
translations.kjv: Moreover I have given to thee one portion above thy brethren, which I took out of the hand of the Amorite with my sword and with my bow.
translations.ron: Deci eu îţi dau ţie, peste ceea ce au fraţii tăi, Sichemul, pe care l-am luat eu cu sabia mea şi cu arcul meu din mâinile Amoreilor".
translations.grk: Ἐγὼ δὲ δίδωμί σοι Σίκιμα ἐξαίρετον ὑπὲρ τοὺς ἀδελφούς σου, ἣν ἔλαβον ἐκ χειρὸς Ἀμοῤῥαίων ἐν μαχαίρᾳ μου καὶ τόξῳ.
